pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoGIS
pyqgis_plugin.description: Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent & Spatial Analysis Studio for QGIS
pyqgis_plugin.about: AutoGIS is an open-source, standalone Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent and Spatial Analysis Studio for QGIS built 100% in Python (PyQGIS + PyQt5). Connect your preferred AI model (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, or OpenRouter) to download live OpenStreetMap vectors, administrative boundaries, STAC Earth Observation rasters, OSRM routes, read large PDFs/documents, decompose large multi-layer GIS projects into step-by-step phases, run QGIS Processing algorithms, and automate PyQGIS workflows.
